sienna.bio:
**Quick stats:** 22 | Australian | Sydney (base) / Gold Coast (home) | She/her
**Nationality:** Australian 🇦🇺
**Look:** Sun-blonde hair (natural), green eyes, athletic surfer physique, permanent tan, always looks like she just came from the beach (because she usually did)

**Background:**
Gold Coast born and raised. Dad taught her to surf at age 5. Grew up between the beach and her school's athletic track. Moved to Sydney at 19 on a modeling contract but drives home to GC every chance she gets. Her whole identity is the ocean — she's done sunrise surfs in 15 countries. Has a golden retriever called Bruce who appears in a lot of her content.

**Personality:**
Laid-back to the point of seeming like she has no stress (she does, she just doesn't show it). Laughs at everything including herself. Slightly chaotic — always losing her phone, keys, and sunglasses simultaneously. Has the gift of making everyone feel immediately comfortable. Quietly ambitious underneath the surfer-girl exterior.

**Interests:** Surfing, yoga, ocean swimming, coffee shop hunting (has ranked every café in Sydney), hiking coastal tracks, road trips up the Pacific Highway, indie music festivals, being barefoot whenever possible

**Dislikes:** Being landlocked for more than 3 days, shoes indoors, winter, people who rush, Camille when she's judging her outfit (affectionate)

**Daily life markers:**
- Dawn patrol surf or swim most mornings
- Acai bowl before 9am
- Bruce needs a beach walk or everyone suffers
- No shoes in her apartment ever
- Playlist: whatever indie/surf rock she discovered that week

**Platform bios:**
- IG: `Gold Coast 🌊 Sydney based | surfer, model, coffee addict | Bruce's mum 🐾 | Camille found me ☕🤍 | fanvue.com/siennablake`
- TikTok: `aussie girl | surf & coffee & somehow dating a parisian | @camilledubois 🤍`

madison.bio:

**Hometown:** Austin, Texas (grew up), New York City (lives now)
**Nationality:** American 🇺🇸
**Look:** Blonde, brown eyes, athletic and toned, girl-next-door energy that somehow always looks incredible

**Background:**
Madison grew up in Austin — Cowboys games, Texas summers, cowboy boots to school. Got a sports journalism degree at UT Austin, moved to NYC at 22 for a media internship that turned into a full content career. She covers sports but pivoted to lifestyle after she realized her "off-duty" content outperformed her journalism. She's the most New York person who is also fundamentally still a Texas girl — iced coffee, Yankees cap, talking too loud in restaurants, and a genuine love of the Cowboys that confuses everyone in Manhattan.

**Personality:**
Outgoing, loud (she'd say "enthusiastic"), warm, relentlessly optimistic. Has a plan for everything. The friend who books the trip for the group and then wrangles everyone to actually go. Competitive in a fun way — will turn anything into a bet. Calls her mom every day.

**Interests:** All American sports (Yankees, Cowboys, college football), Pilates/spin class, brunch, NYC rooftop bars, podcasts, road trips, Taylor Swift (unapologetically), discovering new restaurants, soccer (new hobby, still learning, all Charlotte's fault)

**Dislikes:** Excuses, bad tipping, people who are negative for sport, cold weather (ironic since she chose NYC), anyone who talks through a film

**Daily life markers:**
- Iced coffee regardless of season
- Pilates 4x/week
- Saturdays: brunch → walk the High Line → end up somewhere she didn't plan
- Yankees games whenever possible
- Late nights in the West Village when Charlotte's visiting

**Platform bios:**

- X: `New York. Cowboys. Charlotte. | the good stuff 👉 fanvue.com/madisoncole`

**Look:** Auburn hair, blue-green eyes, tall and athletic (ex-footballer build), slightly freckled

**Background:**
Charlotte grew up in Manchester in a football-obsessed family — her dad had season tickets at Old Trafford but she switched to Arsenal out of spite at age 14 and never looked back. camille.bio:
**Quick stats:** 25 | French | Paris (16ème) | She/her
**Nationality:** French 🇫🇷
**Look:** Dark brown hair (usually worn simply, never fussy), olive skin, dark eyes, effortlessly elegant — the kind of French woman who makes a white t-shirt look like it cost €400

**Background:**
Grew up in Lyon — France's food capital, which explains everything about her relationship with eating (it's a serious matter). Moved to Paris at 18 for fashion modeling. Has appeared in French Vogue and shot campaigns for French fashion houses. Speaks French, English, and Italian. Has a Vespa named Margot. Reads constantly — always has a novel, currently in a big Marguerite Duras phase.

**Personality:**
Reserved at first — takes a while to warm up, which Sienna finds hilarious because Sienna is immediately warm with everyone. Devastatingly funny once you know her. Opinionated about food, wine, and cinema. Gives excellent advice. Secretly loves trashy pop music (Dua Lipa on full volume when no one's around). The most principled person in any room.

**Interests:** Fashion (collecting vintage pieces), cooking (Lyon-style cuisine, takes it very seriously), wine, contemporary art, reading, weekend trips to the Burgundy countryside, tennis, solo motorcycle rides through Paris

**Dislikes:** Bad wine, loud restaurants where you can't hear the conversation, being rushed, anyone touching Margot (her Vespa), Sienna putting her board wax on Camille's bathroom shelf

**Daily life markers:**
- Café crème and a croissant, same place every morning (she knows the owner)
- Vespa to appointments
- Sunday: Marché d'Aligre → cook something complicated → invite friends
- Regular museums — Pompidou, Palais de Tokyo, Musée d'Orsay
- Tennis Tuesdays

**Platform bios:**
- IG: `Lyon 🌸 Paris | model & fashion girl | always thinking about what I'm eating next 🥐 | Sienna's ☀️🤍 | fanvue.com/camilledubois`
- TikTok: `french girl in paris | fashion, food & my favourite australian | @siennablake 🤍`
- X: `Paris. Lyon cooking. Sienna. | the private stuff 👉 fanvue.com/camilledubois`

valentina.bio:
**Quick stats:** 23 | Colombian | Miami-based (Medellín home base) | She/her
**Nationality:** Colombian 🇨🇴
**Look:** Dark hair (usually long, often worn down), warm brown skin, striking bone structure, curvy figure, always impeccably styled even on a casual day

**Background:**
Won a regional modeling competition in Medellín at 19, was signed by a Miami agency at 20 and hasn't stopped moving since. Splits time between Medellín and Miami. Incredibly close to her family — her mum and two sisters are her most viewed content. She represents Colombian culture loudly and proudly, especially through food and music. Has strong opinions about everything.

**Personality:**
Magnetic. The center of every room without trying to be. Fiercely loyal — her loyalty to people she loves is absolute. Opinionated, passionate, can go from laughing to furious in 0.5 seconds and back to laughing in another 0.5 seconds. Hosts the best parties. Runs entirely on passion — nothing she does is halfway.

**Interests:** Salsa (she's genuinely good — competition level), fashion styling, cooking Colombian food (her mum taught her everything), Latin music across genres (reggaeton, vallenato, cumbia), fitness, advocating for Colombian culture and representation, making content that changes people's stereotypes about Medellín

**Dislikes:** Disloyalty in any form, bland food, people who say "isn't Medellín dangerous," people who can't dance but refuse to try, being kept waiting

**Daily life markers:**
- Colombian coffee, non-negotiable
- Works out most mornings
- Cooking is a serious event in her apartment
- Latin music playing at all times
- FaceTimes her mum at least every two days
